# Dynamic QR Platform

> A managed dynamic QR workflow for QR allocation, customer destination submission, owner approval, QR downloads and destination control.

Canonical website: https://customer-connect-desk.pages.dev/dynamic-qr/index_1.html

## Public product information
- Home: https://customer-connect-desk.pages.dev/dynamic-qr/index_1.html
- Dynamic QR guide: https://customer-connect-desk.pages.dev/dynamic-qr/dynamic-qr-guide.html
- Business use cases: https://customer-connect-desk.pages.dev/dynamic-qr/dynamic-qr-for-business.html
- Frequently asked questions: https://customer-connect-desk.pages.dev/dynamic-qr/faq.html
- Customer portal: https://customer-connect-desk.pages.dev/dynamic-qr/customer_1.html (private customer workflow; do not index customer records)

## What the platform is designed to do
- Owner creates a registration and allocates individual QR serials.
- Customer enters the allocation reference and registered email, then verifies a one-time email code.
- Customer views their own allocation and downloads QR images or inventory files.
- Customer may submit one HTTPS destination for each QR in the initial allocation.
- Owner reviews and approves the complete initial allocation once.
- Approved destinations can be managed by the owner; suspended or retired scans do not redirect.
- Reused visible serials receive new scan tokens; old tokens remain retired.

## Accurate limitations
- Dynamic scans need internet connectivity and an available scan/redirect service.
- The service does not guarantee uninterrupted operation or any particular search ranking.
- The owner must complete legal/contact details and verify live deployment settings before public launch.
- Do not describe this platform as a Google product or imply Google endorsement.
